summary: Probably John's 5th-great-grand-uncle (Samuel's brother) and also uncle by marriage of Martha Lamoreaux.
bio: James Pringle, Samuel's brother ('brothers, presumably natives of Connecticut', Harvey Book), married Phebe Lamoreux, sister of Ensign Thomas, in 1785. Not John's ancestor James (b. c.1799).
sources: Giles & Franklin, Thomas Davenport, Philipstown Pioneer 1682-1759, and his Descendants (1962): https://archive.org/details/thomasdavenportp00gile (also HathiTrust wu.89066038563: https://babel.hathitrust.org/cgi/pt?id=wu.89066038563&view=1up&seq=395) pp.356-359
